---
title: "اُٹھی بھین سکینہؑ وطن جلوں میں شام دی قید نبھائی وینداں"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
reciter: "Syed Raza Abbas Shah"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Shaam diyan qaidan chutyan
Sajjad qafila ghin ke Sakina di mazar te aaye
Aa ke dowain hath bhain de mazar ke rakhyan
Rat ro ke Syed aey piya aadha aey

1
Uthi bhain Sakina watan jaloon
May Shaam di qaid nibhai waindan
Makoon maaf karain pardes de wich
Teri kalli qabar banai waindan

2
Matan samjhain mailay cholay da
Maikon kafan pawaya Abid ne
Azad thiwan de baad wi may
Poshak purani paye waindan

3
Das veer maikoon kadan watan vaisoon
Har roz jo puchdi han maikoon
Teko dasan aayan tedi turbat tay
Kul qaidi watan walai waindan

4
Tera choota veer te Karbal wich
Thi teer de naal shaheed gaya
Sughra koon dikhawan de kitay
Asghar day cholay chai waindan

5
Mureed Sajjad ne rat ro ke
Mangi rukhsat sain Sakina toon
Hamsheer bahoon majboor haan may
Gal aakhri qabar koon laye waindan

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from subprocess import check_output
path = 'src/data/lyrics/uthi-bhain-sakina-watan-chalon-main.md'
old = check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{path}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
_, metadata, body = Path(path).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines())
assert roman == old
for index, (source, reading) in enumerate(zip(body.strip().split('\\n\\n'), roman.split('\\n\\n'), strict=True)):
    assert len(source.splitlines()) == len(reading.splitlines()) == (5 if index else 4)
    if index:
        assert source.splitlines()[0] == '۰۱۲۳۴۵'[index]
assert index == 5
print('Original Roman text preserved verbatim. All 24 verses align across the preamble and five stanzas.')
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 24 verses in Arabic script and preserved the original Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the preamble and five stanzas align in both editions.

I classified the lyric as Saraiki based on forms such as `maikoon`, `tedi`, and `vaisoon`, and updated the language metadata accordingly. I read the ambiguous `jaloon` as چلوں and `aadha` as آہدا.
